newsitem.title: PERU: Peru to keep minority share in hydrocarbon firms.
newsitem.headline: Peru to keep minority share in hydrocarbon firms.

text.p: Peru's Congress passed Wednesday a new law mandating the government to keep a minority stake, with special voting rights, in privatized companies from the hydrocarbon sector.
The Special Law For Privatizing State Hydrocarbon Companies, approved by 61 votes to seven, stipulates that the state will always maintain one or more shares in companies it sells in the future.

That will give the government a "determining vote" in privatized companies' decisions in certain areas such as the incorporation of new shareholders, reduction of capital, listing of shares, and merger or dissolution of the firms.
The law follows criticism from the government that it is ceding too much control of the oil industry to the private sector through the ongoing privatization of state oil company Petroperu.
